info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Insurance Claims Claims Payouts-v5-spec
info.description: The Insurance Claims Payouts API provides a streamlined way to retrieve detailed information about insurance claims payouts. This endpoint allows users to access payout data associated with specific insurance claims, which is crucial for claims processing and financial reconciliation. Typical consumers include insurance agents, claims adjusters, and financial analysts who require insights into payouts for reporting and auditing purposes. By leveraging this API, stakeholders can ensure efficient management of claim payouts and enhance customer service.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the payout details associated with a specific claim. It provides necessary data for analyzing claim payouts and helps in financial reconciliation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the payout information for claims. It should include all necessary parameters in JSON format to specify the desired claim details.
